claim_scope: Fixed normal compatibility observations only. No detection superiority, general semantic equivalence, cause attribution, A-policy fairness or N4-1 completion claim.
derivation: Counts verified against original tool commands.jsonl; no experiment record/aggregate used. Boundary verdicts use direct .sym indices only. Input/witness values are absent from this evidence file.

versions_and_conditions.cache: empty application cache per condition; identical full compile key reused only within condition; OS cache not flushed
versions_and_conditions.normal_inputs: three predeclared inputs per fixture; same declared boundary input adapters for O0/O1; adapters do not supply missing-symbol evidence
versions_and_conditions.preparation_scope: automatic discovery/wrappers + original/wrapper compiles + dependency/cache provenance hashing
versions_and_conditions.normal_validation_scope: normal calculation + constraint check + witness export + direct symbol boundary comparison and normal output oracle
versions_and_conditions.excluded_timing: tool/source snapshots, versions, final manifest/report, cargo/regression checks
versions_and_conditions.prohibited_extensions: no O2, inverse optimization, new project, fuzzing, candidate generation, experiment aggregate

time_accounting.unknown_reason: Historical active-work time is unmeasured; process wall and documentation interval are not human effort.
